title: app.del() removed
description: Express 5 removes app.del(). Use app.delete() instead.

detection.note: Search for .del( — any call to app.del() or router.del()

title: req.param(name) removed
description: req.param() has been removed. Use req.params, req.body, or req.query explicitly.

title: Pluralized method names removed
description: req.acceptsCharset() is removed. Use req.acceptsCharsets() instead.

detection.note: Search for singular forms of these three request methods

source: Removed methods and properties > Pluralized method names

title: res.json(obj, status) signature removed
description: res.json(obj, status) is no longer supported. Use res.status(code).json(obj).

detection.note: Search for res.json( with a numeric status code as second argument

source: Removed methods and properties > res.json(obj, status)

title: res.redirect('back') removed
description: The magic string 'back' is no longer supported. Use the Referer header with a fallback.
source: Removed methods and properties > res.redirect('back') and res.location('back')

title: res.send(body, status) argument order changed
description: res.send(obj, status) is removed. Use res.status(code).send(obj).

detection.note: Search for res.send( with a numeric status code as second argument

source: Removed methods and properties > res.send(body, status)

title: express.static() 'hidden' option replaced by 'dotfiles'
description: The 'hidden' option for express.static() is no longer supported. Use dotfiles: 'allow' instead.

detection.note: Search for express.static( with 'hidden' in options

source: Removed methods and properties > express.static() options

title: app.listen() errors passed to callback
description: Server errors are now passed to the app.listen callback instead of being thrown.

detection.note: Search for app.listen( — check whether the callback handles errors
